comment:
* Defines the infrastructure to support extended socket options, beyond those
 * defined in {@link java.net.StandardSocketOptions}.
 *
 * Extended socket options are accessed through the jdk.net API, which is in
 * the jdk.net module.

methods.name: public final boolean isOptionSupported(SocketOption<?> option)
methods.comment: Tells whether or not the option is supported.

methods.name: public final Set<SocketOption<?>> options()
methods.comment: Return the, possibly empty, set of extended socket options available.

methods.name: public static final Set<SocketOption<?>> options(short type)
public abstract void setOption(FileDescriptor fd, SocketOption<?> option, Object value) throws SocketException
methods.comment: Sets the value of a socket option, for the given socket.

methods.name: public abstract Object getOption(FileDescriptor fd, SocketOption<?> option) throws SocketException
methods.comment: Returns the value of a socket option, for the given socket.

methods.name: public static final void register(ExtendedSocketOptions extOptions)
methods.comment: Registers support for extended socket options. Invoked by the jdk.net module.
